mapper.select: SELECT 'Memo' as tt, memoid, memo as title, DATE_FORMAT(startdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start, 'false' as allDay FROM ttokssaemdb.memo WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND startdate BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.memo ( branchid, memberid, memo, startdate, regdate ) VALUES ( #{session_branchid}, #{memberid}, #{memo}, STR_TO_DATE(#{start}, '%Y-%m-%d'), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT memo.memoid, memo.memo, member.membername, DATE_FORMAT(memo.regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') regdate FROM ttokssaemdb.memo memo, ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE memo.memberid = member.memberid AND memo.branchid = #{session_branchid} AND memo.regdate >= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -36 HOUR) ORDER BY memo.memoid DESC
